title: ABRA — Architecture Review
subtitle: The scathing review, the eleven standards that follow from it, and what is enforced by what.
author: Will Hooper
note: Read this as one piece. Section 1 is the list of faults this project actually shipped. Section 2 turns each fault into a rule with a literature basis. Section 4 is the table that says which check enforces which rule - a standard with no check in that column is only a preference. The changelog entries at the end record the two releases this review produced.
